shellCommands.command: node server.js & sleep 1; echo "--- add book 1 ---"; curl -si -X POST localhost:3000/books -d 'title=The+Left+Hand+of+Darkness&author=Ursula+K.+Le+Guin&notes=Great+so+far' | head -5; echo "--- add book 2 ---"; curl -si -X POST localhost:3000/books -d 'title=Piranesi&author=Susanna+Clarke' | head -3

kill %1; sleep 0.5; node server.js & sleep 1; curl -s localhost:3000/ | grep -cE "Left Hand|Piranesi"; curl -s localhost:3000/books/7699c65b-3b4d-43a0-b145-8f3519d41cbd | grep -o "Updated: mind-blowing worldbuilding"; kill %1; cat data/books.json | head -20
pkill -f "node server.js"; sleep 0.5; node server.js & sleep 1; echo "books on home after restart: $(curl -s localhost:3000/ | grep -cE 'Left Hand|Piranesi')"; pkill -f "node server.js"

node server.js > /tmp/bt.log 2>&1 & sleep 1; echo "books on home after fresh restart: $(curl -s localhost:3000/ | grep -cE 'Left Hand|Piranesi')"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "detail page: %{http_code}\n" localhost:3000/books/d2ab2e6c-06c7-496e-bb82-f57ba69445ae; pkill -f "node server.js"
